meta.title: Sell Lemons income sources data

sources.label: BloxByte Games Mini Wiki - Sell Lemons
Pro Game Guides - Sell Lemons Beginner's Guide

uncertainFacts: Exact unlock thresholds are not source-verified for every income source. Rows use Needs in-game check instead of guessed costs when a source does not give a reliable value.
The final source is shown as Orange X in selllemons.com and as LemonX in sellemons.wiki and Fandom source lists. The row uses Orange X with alternateName LemonX per parent approval.
No acceptable direct station screenshots were found in the research pass, so row image fields stay empty.

items.name: Lemon Stand
items.managerAutomation: Cash Register Automator removes the click loop
items.keyUpgrades: Juicer; Cup Stand; Street Flyers; 2x Stand Cash
items.resetNote: Normal stand upgrades reset after Evolution; investor and permanent multiplier progress make rebuying faster.
items.bestUse: Buy Juicer and automation early so the stand keeps earning while you unlock LemonDash.
items.cardSummary: Lemon Stand is the first cash source. It teaches the core loop: click, collect ground cash, buy yield upgrades, then automate the stand.
items.verificationNote: Starting role, clicking loop, ground cash, and key upgrades are cross-checked across sellemons.wiki and selllemons.com.

items.name: LemonDash
items.playStyle: Active delivery, then passive with manager
items.managerAutomation: LemonDash Manager automates deliveries after fee and speed upgrades matter
items.keyUpgrades: Delivery Fees; Vehicle Speed; Order Tier upgrades
items.resetNote: Normal delivery progress resets with the run, but later multipliers make the unlock quick to rebuild.
items.bestUse: Rush it after the stand is stable because delivery payouts can skip early grind.
items.cardSummary: LemonDash turns the stand business into delivery orders. It is the first major active income spike after the basic stand.
items.verificationNote: Unlock cost and delivery role from sellemons.wiki; manager and upgrade role cross-checked with selllemons.com and Pro Game Guides.

items.name: Lemon Depot
items.unlock: After the early stand and delivery route
items.managerAutomation: Depot Manager automates bulk sales after core multipliers are upgraded
items.keyUpgrades: Per-click income; Depot multipliers; Depot Roof; Depot Walls; Depot Lights
items.resetNote: Depot structures reset, and hidden button gates need to be rebuilt each run.
items.bestUse: Sweep the Depot after buying decorations because roof, wall, and light purchases can reveal major buttons.
items.cardSummary: Lemon Depot moves the run into bulk selling. It is also where hidden decoration gates can make players think progression stopped.
items.verificationNote: Wholesale role, manager, and decoration-gate facts are source-backed; exact unlock threshold still needs direct in-game check.

items.name: Lemon Trading
items.managerAutomation: Trading Manager automates basic buy and sell decisions once market rhythm is understood
items.resetNote: Open trading progress resets with the run; avoid large trades right before a reset.
items.bestUse: Use it as supplemental income until you understand price swings and can afford mistakes.
items.cardSummary: Lemon Trading adds a stock-market style loop. It can pay well, but bad timing can set a run back.
items.verificationNote: Trading role and risk warnings are source-backed; exact unlock threshold still needs direct in-game check.

items.name: Lemon Labs
items.managerAutomation: Labs Manager automates research output when permanent upgrades are active
items.keyUpgrades: Permanent upgrades; 8x income boost; Time-skip boosts; Labs Equipment
items.resetNote: Permanent Labs upgrades are the ones to prioritize before a long reset route.
items.bestUse: Prioritize permanent upgrades because they improve every future rebuild.
items.cardSummary: Lemon Labs is the first source where reset planning becomes the point. Its permanent upgrades can matter more than short-term cash.
items.verificationNote: Permanent upgrade and time-skip role are source-backed; exact unlock threshold and individual permanent flags need in-game check.

items.name: Lemon Robotics
items.managerAutomation: Robotics Manager improves late-game automation after Robotics upgrades are funded
items.keyUpgrades: Full automation; manager efficiency; Robotics scaling upgrades
items.resetNote: High Evolution multipliers can make Robotics a skip target before rebuilding lower tiers.
items.bestUse: Push it when rebuild speed is high enough that automation beats step-by-step lower-tier grinding.
items.cardSummary: Lemon Robotics turns the run toward heavy automation. In high-Evolution play, it can become a priority target after a reset.
items.verificationNote: Automation role and high-Evolution skip framing are source-backed; exact unlock threshold and upgrade names need direct in-game check.

items.name: Lemon Republic
items.managerAutomation: Focused on global scaling instead of a separate manager
items.keyUpgrades: Central Bank; political upgrades; sovereignty multipliers
items.resetNote: Republic value scales hard with Ascend and Evolution multipliers, but normal source progress still belongs to the run.
items.bestUse: Use it to amplify earlier sources before pushing toward Orange X.
items.cardSummary: Lemon Republic is the seventh source and shifts the business into global multiplier scaling.
items.verificationNote: Unlock threshold from selllemons.com. Central Bank and global multiplier role are source-backed; manager behavior is not verified.

items.name: Orange X
items.managerAutomation: Focused on cosmic scaling instead of a separate manager
items.keyUpgrades: Rocket build; Moon base; UFO Key zone; Ascension scaling
items.resetNote: Orange X/LemonX depends on deep Evolution and Ascension progress more than normal early-run upgrades.
items.bestUse: Treat it as the final long-term target after Republic and Ascension systems are established.
items.cardSummary: Orange X is the final income source. Some sources call it LemonX, but both names point to the space-tier endgame source.
items.verificationNote: Final-tier role, Moon/rocket context, and LemonX alternate naming are source-backed. Exact unlock threshold and UFO Key requirements need direct in-game check.
